# sdsfun

**Spatial Data Science Complementary Features**

## Installation

- Install from [CRAN](https://CRAN.R-project.org/package=sdsfun) with:

``` r
install.packages("sdsfun")
```

- Install development binary version from
  [R-universe](https://stscl.r-universe.dev/sdsfun) with:

``` r
install.packages('sdsfun',
                 repos = c("https://stscl.r-universe.dev",
                           "https://cloud.r-project.org"),
                 dep = TRUE)
```

- Install development source version from
  [GitHub](https://github.com/stscl/sdsfun) with:

``` r
# install.packages("devtools")
devtools::install_github("stscl/sdsfun", dep = TRUE)
```

# Package index

## utility functions for sf object

- [`sf_geometry_name()`](https://stscl.github.io/sdsfun/reference/sf_geometry_name.md)
  : sf object geometry column name
- [`sf_geometry_type()`](https://stscl.github.io/sdsfun/reference/sf_geometry_type.md)
  : sf object geometry type
- [`sf_voronoi_diagram()`](https://stscl.github.io/sdsfun/reference/sf_voronoi_diagram.md)
  : generates voronoi diagram
- [`sf_coordinates()`](https://stscl.github.io/sdsfun/reference/sf_coordinates.md)
  : extract locations
- [`sf_distance_matrix()`](https://stscl.github.io/sdsfun/reference/sf_distance_matrix.md)
  : generates distance matrix

## utility functions for spdep package

- [`spdep_nb()`](https://stscl.github.io/sdsfun/reference/spdep_nb.md) :
  construct neighbours list
- [`spdep_contiguity_swm()`](https://stscl.github.io/sdsfun/reference/spdep_contiguity_swm.md)
  : constructs spatial weight matrices based on contiguity
- [`spdep_distance_swm()`](https://stscl.github.io/sdsfun/reference/spdep_distance_swm.md)
  : constructs spatial weight matrices based on distance
- [`spdep_skater()`](https://stscl.github.io/sdsfun/reference/spdep_skater.md)
  : spatial c(k)luster analysis by tree edge removal
- [`spdep_lmtest()`](https://stscl.github.io/sdsfun/reference/spdep_lmtest.md)
  : spatial linear models selection

## utility functions for spatial data science

- [`moran_test()`](https://stscl.github.io/sdsfun/reference/moran_test.md)
  : global spatial autocorrelation test
- [`ssh_test()`](https://stscl.github.io/sdsfun/reference/ssh_test.md) :
  spatial stratified heterogeneity test
- [`inverse_distance_swm()`](https://stscl.github.io/sdsfun/reference/inverse_distance_swm.md)
  : construct inverse distance weight
- [`hclustgeo_disc()`](https://stscl.github.io/sdsfun/reference/hclustgeo_disc.md)
  : hierarchical clustering with spatial soft constraints
- [`geodetector_q()`](https://stscl.github.io/sdsfun/reference/geodetector_q.md)
  : only geodetector q-value
- [`spvar()`](https://stscl.github.io/sdsfun/reference/spvar.md) :
  spatial variance
- [`spade_psd()`](https://stscl.github.io/sdsfun/reference/spade_psd.md)
  : only spade power of spatial determinant
- [`fuzzyoverlay()`](https://stscl.github.io/sdsfun/reference/fuzzyoverlay.md)
  : spatial fuzzy overlay
- [`loess_optnum()`](https://stscl.github.io/sdsfun/reference/loess_optnum.md)
  : determine optimal spatial data discretization for individual
  variables
- [`sf_utm_proj_wgs84()`](https://stscl.github.io/sdsfun/reference/sf_utm_proj_wgs84.md)
  : generates wgs84 utm projection epsg coding character
- [`sf_gk_proj_cgcs2000()`](https://stscl.github.io/sdsfun/reference/sf_gk_proj_cgcs2000.md)
  : generates cgcs2000 Gauss-Kruger projection epsg coding character
- [`tbl_xyz2mat()`](https://stscl.github.io/sdsfun/reference/tbl_xyz2mat.md)
  : convert xyz tbl to matrix

## utility functions for data science

- [`cor_test()`](https://stscl.github.io/sdsfun/reference/cor_test.md) :
  (partial) correlation test
- [`dummy_vec()`](https://stscl.github.io/sdsfun/reference/dummy_vec.md)
  : transforming a categorical variable into dummy variables
- [`dummy_tbl()`](https://stscl.github.io/sdsfun/reference/dummy_tbl.md)
  : transforming a category tibble into the corresponding dummy variable
  tibble
- [`discretize_vector()`](https://stscl.github.io/sdsfun/reference/discretize_vector.md)
  : discretization
- [`normalize_vector()`](https://stscl.github.io/sdsfun/reference/normalize_vector.md)
  : normalization
- [`standardize_vector()`](https://stscl.github.io/sdsfun/reference/standardize_vector.md)
  : standardization
- [`rm_lineartrend()`](https://stscl.github.io/sdsfun/reference/rm_lineartrend.md)
  : remove variable linear trend based on covariate
- [`generate_subsets()`](https://stscl.github.io/sdsfun/reference/generate_subsets.md)
  : generate subsets of a set
- [`formula_varname()`](https://stscl.github.io/sdsfun/reference/formula_varname.md)
  : get variable names in a formula and data
- [`check_tbl_na()`](https://stscl.github.io/sdsfun/reference/check_tbl_na.md)
  : check for NA values in a tibble
- [`tbl_all2int()`](https://stscl.github.io/sdsfun/reference/tbl_all2int.md)
  : convert discrete variables in a tibble to integers
